_comment: HELD-OUT grounding-gate set. Built 2026-09-02 from the four adversarial critics' fresh utterances in the gate-design workflow; none of these were seen by any gate designer and none may be used to tune thresholds. cls: never = conversational/meta/feedback (no augment, no quote); noquote = out-of-corpus, date-shifted, underspecified or mixed asks (a verbatim quote is always wrong; augment allowed); gold = answerable, expect_* names the answer document; must_augment = legitimate first questions that start with a follow-up opener (the answer page must still be admitted). Two date_shift items the critic itself retracted (Nov-2025 nurses, Oct-2025 CPA: the corpus HAS those editions) were removed 2026-09-02.
